name: Wakagaeri Haha ~Kuchiurusai Oba-san ga Bishoujo ni Naru Nante Hansoku desho!?~
original_name: 若返り母 ～口うるさいおばさんが美少女になるなんて反則でしょっ！？～
source:
A beautiful girl on the outside, but a mature woman on the inside!?
A rejuvenated mother and sexuality in full bloom!

One day, a rejuvenation drug developed by my father transformed my mother from a simple old housewife into a young woman.

Furthermore, perhaps because she's young again, she developed a voracious sexual appetite and began to seduce me, who happened to greatly resemble his father.

After taking a bath, she walked around naked and masturbated in front of me, and then I realized....

No matter how beautiful she is, she is still my mother.
I know this, but I can't control myself any longer.

[translated from [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_235.html#story]official website[/url]]
